profile.summary: A public community college district in northern Alameda County, California. It is made up of four colleges: Berkeley City College, College of Alameda, Laney College and Merritt College. The colleges offer two-year degrees, certificates and university transfer programs.

review.notes: Cited peralta.edu pages confirm the four colleges (including Laney College), the Oakland district office address at 333 East Eighth Street, phone (510) 466-7200, and two-year degree, certificate and transfer programs. This matches the agenda's Oakland location and the Gateway to College at Laney, CCAP and pathways agreements. The summary is neutral and supported.
